summary: Inspira Technologies Oxy B.H.N. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders was held on May 6, 2026, after an initial adjournment due to lack of quorum. At the adjourned meeting, shareholders voted and approved a described agenda item referenced in a prior filing. This is a routine procedural report on a shareholder meeting outcome, not a special situation event. No deal terms, strategic changes, or material corporate action are disclosed. The filing serves to incorporate the report by reference into the company's registration statements.
